title: Personal Injury Filing Deadlines and Fault Rules by State (2026)
note: General negligence deadlines for adults (car accidents, slip and fall, premises liability). Medical malpractice, product liability, wrongful death, and claims against government entities carry different and often shorter deadlines. Compiled from state statutes as of July 2026. This is general information, not legal advice; confirm with a licensed attorney in your state.

rows.note: One of just 4 states plus DC still using the all-or-nothing contributory rule.
